# Schoolio / Sekolah Pintar — AI Handoff

Indonesian-first multi-tenant school management web app. Next.js 16 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript + Prisma + PostgreSQL. Tenant boundary: `SchoolProfile.id`.

## Documentation Reading Order

1. `docs/AGENT_HANDOFF.md` — START HERE. Workflow protocol, rules, commands, current focus.
2. `docs/BUILD_LOGS.md` — Recent work history. READ before starting. APPEND after finishing.
3. `docs/PRODUCT.md` — Product direction, roadmap, priorities, acceptance criteria.
4. `docs/TECHNICAL.md` — Architecture, 47 models, 95 API routes, RBAC, auth, conventions.
5. `docs/DESIGN.md` — Visual direction, color tokens, components, illustration style.
6. `prisma/schema.prisma` — Domain model source of truth.
7. `lib/api.ts` — requireAuth, requireRole, requireSchoolContext, parseJsonBody, jsonOk, jsonError.
8. `lib/authz.ts` — RBAC + ownership helpers.
9. `lib/schemas.ts` — All Zod schemas (add here, never inline).
10. `middleware.ts` — Auth gating, onboarding gating, CSRF enforcement, correlation ID.

For feature work: `app/api/<feature>/route.ts` + `lib/handlers/<feature>.ts` + `components/pages/<Feature>.tsx`.

## Critical Rules

- Never accept userId/authorId/studentId/teacherId from request body — derive from actor.
- Every protected route: `requireAuth` → `requireRole` → `requireSchoolContext`.
- Every Prisma query scoped by `schoolId`.
- Zod schemas in `lib/schemas.ts` only. Business logic in `lib/handlers/<feature>.ts` only.
- Use existing shadcn/Radix components. Never add alternative UI libraries.
- After every task: append to `docs/BUILD_LOGS.md` with git staging instructions.
- Do NOT run `git add` or `git commit`. Document what to stage and commit.
- Indonesian conventional commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `chore:`.

## Commands

```bash
npm run dev                           # Next.js dev server
npm run build                         # Production build
npm run lint                          # ESLint
npm run test                          # Vitest
npm run prisma:migrate                # Database migrations
npm run prisma:studio                 # Database GUI
npm run test:release-authz-integrity  # Authorization gate
```

## Current Focus

Phase 2 — UX Polish: EmptyState component, error boundaries, role-scoped dashboards, i18n framework. See `docs/PRODUCT.md` for full roadmap.
